name: (UPD) Phantom Ball
desc:
🔥 Welcome to PHANTOM BALL, in this game you'll deflect a ball back and forth to eliminate other players. The last person standing wins!

💎 Earn diamonds and spend them on new items!
✨ Collect boosts around the map for temporary speed buffs!
🌠 Level up and achieve different leagues!
🏆 Show off your wins streak and climb the leaderboards!

CONTROLS:
Block - F / Tap / UI Button / Left Click
Ability 1 - Q / Tap / UI Button
Ability 2 - 1 / Tap / UI Button
Passive - Happens automatically

⚠️ Exploiting and auto farming are strictly prohibited! Our anti cheat and moderators will catch you, and you'll permanently banned with no appeal.
* Macros and Auto Clickers are allowed in the AFK lobby.

🖤 By Jule Games
